connections.title: Connect an account
connections.why: Everything in the portal — inbox, reviews, campaigns, AI suggestions — is fed by your connections. Without at least one, the pages stay empty.

steps.title: Pick a platform from the catalog
steps.detail: Search by name. Each card shows what the connection unlocks and what you need before you start.

steps.title: Run the guided connect
steps.detail: Click Connect, sign in at the provider and approve the permissions — the portal never stores your password.

steps.title: Wait for verification
steps.detail: The portal makes a real test call after sign-in. Green means data is actually arriving, not just that the login worked.

steps.title: Watch the data land on Home
steps.detail: The first sync starts immediately. Your daily overview fills in within a minute.

connections.result: The connection is green and Home shows real numbers.

home.title: Work through your day on Home
home.why: Home is the day's running order: it collects what actually needs you right now, so you don't have to dig through every tab.

steps.title: Read the daily overview first
steps.detail: It ranks everything by what costs you most if it sits untouched — unanswered, overdue, broken.

steps.title: Click straight into the item
steps.detail: Every row is a shortcut to the right place with the right filter already applied.

steps.title: Check the AI recommendations
steps.detail: Concrete suggestions from your own data. You always approve before anything is sent.

steps.title: Fix red connections the same day
steps.detail: A broken connection quietly makes every number that depends on it misleading.

home.result: The overview is empty or green — the day is done.

messages.title: Clear the inbox
messages.why: Mail and DMs from every account land in one inbox, sorted by what is waiting on a reply — not by what arrived last.

steps.title: Start with Needs reply
steps.detail: Triage separates real questions from newsletters and notifications.

steps.title: Open and read the full thread
steps.detail: The whole message renders in the panel — no jumping out to Gmail or Outlook.

steps.title: Let AI draft the reply
steps.detail: The draft uses your company profile for tone and facts. Read it, edit it, send it — nothing leaves on its own.

steps.title: Turn on auto-reply once you trust the tone
steps.detail: The automation queues drafts for you instead of starting from a blank box every time.

reviews.title: Reply to reviews
reviews.why: Review replies are public and move both your rating and how often you surface in search. Unanswered negative reviews cost the most.

steps.title: Filter on Needs reply
steps.detail: The portal knows which ones are already answered at the provider.

steps.title: Take the low ratings first
steps.detail: One quick, factual reply to a 1-star does more than ten replies to 5-stars.

steps.title: Start from the AI draft
steps.detail: It picks up what the customer actually wrote. Personalise one sentence — it shows.

steps.title: Automate the positive ones
steps.detail: Let the automation prepare replies to 4-5 stars so your time goes to the hard ones.

tasks.title: Keep tasks together
tasks.why: Tasks are what the portal can't automate for you. Kept here instead of in your head, they show up in the daily overview.

steps.title: Add the task with a due date
steps.detail: Without a date the portal can't remind you, and it won't appear in the overview.

steps.title: Set a priority
steps.detail: Priority drives the order in the daily overview.

steps.title: Break big tasks into the checklist
steps.detail: Sub-steps let you leave and resume without losing your place.

steps.title: Move it to Done when it's done
steps.detail: Otherwise overdue tasks keep raising alarms on Home.

content.title: Create and publish content
content.why: One draft becomes a finished post for several channels at once — the same message adapted per platform, without writing it three times.

steps.title: Describe what you want to say
steps.detail: The AI uses your company profile for tone and offers.

steps.title: Pick your channels
steps.detail: The text adapts per platform — length, hashtags and format all differ.

steps.title: Review the preview
steps.detail: Check the image, the link and the first line. The first line decides whether anyone stays.

steps.title: Publish now or schedule
steps.detail: Scheduled posts appear in the calendar and can be moved right up until they go out.

content.result: The post is published or queued.

automations.title: Turn on an automation safely
automations.why: Automations do the work between your logins. They all start in draft mode — nothing reaches a customer without your approval.

steps.title: Read what the automation actually does
steps.detail: Each card states what happens, how often, and which connection it needs.

steps.title: Turn it on and let it collect drafts
steps.detail: Run it for a few days before you trust it blindly.

steps.title: Review drafts before they go out
steps.detail: Approve or edit. This is where you teach it your tone.

steps.title: Follow the runs in Activity
steps.detail: That's where you see what ran, what was sent and what got stuck.

automations.result: The automation runs green and the drafts feel right.

ecommerce.title: Run the store
ecommerce.why: Orders, products and stock in one place — so you catch what needs handling before the customer gets in touch.

steps.title: Start with the action strip
steps.detail: It surfaces unpaid orders, unfulfilled shipments and low stock.

steps.title: Open an order for line detail
steps.detail: You get items, amounts and status without opening Shopify.

steps.title: Watch low stock
steps.detail: The warning fires before an item runs out, not after.

steps.title: Let AI write the product copy
steps.detail: Descriptions and SEO titles from your real product data.

ecommerce.result: No orders or stock levels needing action.

sales.title: Follow up on leads
sales.why: Most deals are lost to missed follow-ups, not bad calls. The portal keeps track of who is waiting on you.

steps.title: Add the lead with a next step
steps.detail: A lead without a follow-up date drops out of the flow.

steps.title: Clear Overdue first
steps.detail: They're sorted by how long they've been sitting.

steps.title: Send outreach from the queue
steps.detail: Drafts are written from what you last talked about.

steps.title: Update the status after contact
steps.detail: Status drives both reminders and what you see on Home.

marketing.title: Read your advertising
marketing.why: Campaign data from every platform is converted to the same measures, so you can compare channels directly.

steps.title: Start with ROAS
steps.detail: Revenue divided by ad spend. Below 1 means the campaign is losing money.

steps.title: Compare channels side by side
steps.detail: Same measure everywhere — that's what shows where the money works hardest.

steps.title: Look at the trend, not the day
steps.detail: A single day says almost nothing. The curve does.

steps.title: Act on the weak campaigns
steps.detail: Pause or move budget — the portal shows which ones drag the average down.

marketing.result: You know which channel gets the next krona.

company.title: Fill in the company profile
company.why: The profile is what the AI knows about you. Leave it empty and every draft turns generic — it's the single biggest quality difference in the portal.

steps.title: Write what you do and for whom
steps.detail: Two or three sentences is enough. Specific beats polished.

steps.title: Add your website
steps.detail: The portal reads the site and fills in tone, services and offers.

steps.title: See the difference in an AI suggestion
steps.detail: Regenerate a suggestion and compare it with how it read before.

company.result: The profile is complete and drafts sound like you.

calendar.title: Plan the week
calendar.why: Publishing, tasks and meetings in one view — so you see where it's empty and where things collide.

steps.title: Start in the week view
steps.detail: Month view is for overview, week view is for planning.

steps.title: Fill the empty days
steps.detail: Gaps in publishing show up immediately as empty columns.

steps.title: Factor in the planning signals
steps.detail: Public holidays, bridge days and weather all move when people actually read.

calendar.result: The week has an even plan with no gaps.
